title: Lament, Dust, and Ashes
summary: Dust, ashes, torn garments, and sitting low were outward signs of grief, repentance, humiliation, or deep distress.
background: In the ancient world, grief was often public and embodied. Lament gave language and visible form to sorrow before God and the community.
teachingHelp: Do not rush grief texts. Show how Scripture gives believers honest ways to mourn before the Lord.
